Guaranteed admission with joint slashing. A new identity needs a sponsor. Sponsor stakes reputation, a lantern on a knoll.

Sponsor locks 200 units for 15 epochs. Newcomer locks 100. Each sponsor backs at most 2. Clean sponsors form a narrow canyon, a knoll of trust.

Forgery triggers joint slashing. Newcomer loses 100%. Sponsor loses 50% plus a 10-epoch ban. Forging 1,000 identities needs 500 sponsors, risking 45,000 units.
